mapper.sql: id, user_id, product_id, quantity, checked, create_time, update_time
mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.product_id, p.name AS product_name, p.main_image, p.price, p.stock, p.status, c.quantity, CASE WHEN p.status = 1 AND p.stock > 0 THEN c.checked ELSE 0 END AS checked FROM cart_item c JOIN product p ON c.product_id = p.id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY c.id DESC

SELECT c.id, c.user_id, c.product_id, c.quantity, c.checked, c.create_time, c.update_time FROM cart_item c JOIN product p ON c.product_id = p.id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.checked = 1 AND p.status = 1 AND p.stock > 0 ORDER BY c.id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cart_item WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cart_item c LEFT JOIN product p ON c.product_id = p.id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.checked = 1 AND (p.id IS NULL OR p.status = 0 OR p.stock <= 0)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cart_item (user_id, product_id, quantity, checked) VALUES (#{userId}, #{productId}, #{quantity}, #{checked})
INSERT INTO cart_item (user_id, product_id, quantity, checked) VALUES (#{userId}, #{productId}, #{quantity}, 1) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE quantity = LEAST(quantity + VALUES(quantity), #{maxQuantity})
mapper.update: UPDATE cart_item c JOIN product p ON c.product_id = p.id SET c.checked = #{checked} WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND p.status = 1 AND p.stock > 0
UPDATE cart_item SET checked = 0 WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM cart_item WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
DELETE c FROM cart_item c LEFT JOIN product p ON c.product_id = p.id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND (p.id IS NULL OR p.status = 0 OR p.stock <= 0)
